name: Gachiakuta
description: Accused of murder and thrown into the Pit, a young orphan joins a group of monster fighters with special powers to uncover the truth and seek vengeance.

videos.title: The Sphere
videos.overview: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.

videos.title: The Inhabited
videos.overview: Cast into the Pit, Rudo is saved by the mysterious Enjin who may not have his best interests at heart.

videos.title: The Ground
videos.overview: Enjin is a Giver, a being who can give life to things and draw out their power. Ludo, who has also awakened to his power as a Giver, is scouted by Enjin to join an organization called the Cleaners, which fights against the Spotted Beasts born from garbage. Ludo accepts the offer in order to find a way to return to the Heavenly World where he has lived until now, but he suddenly gets into a fight with his trainer, Zanca.

videos.title: Cleaner HQ
videos.overview: After being introduced to Cleaner HQ, Rudo follows Riyo on a job to learn the business.

videos.title: Raiders
videos.overview: The Cleaners go on a job to save another Sphereite who survived the fall. Rudo tags along to learn more.

videos.title: One Good Strike!!
videos.overview: With the job having gone terribly wrong, Rudo finds himself face to face with a merciless Raider named Jabber.

videos.title: A Score to Settle
videos.overview: Jabber employs a new strategy to get through Rudo's defenses, and another ally joins the fray.

videos.title: Moving Forward
videos.overview: Rudo deals with the emotional aftermath of the Jabber fight and gets a new lead about returning to the Sphere.

videos.title: The City of Graffiti
videos.overview: To get a "spell" for their next mission, the Cleaners head to Canvas Town, where they make a tragic discovery.

videos.title: Penta: The Desert No Man's Land
videos.overview: With their gear-up complete, the crew heads into the No Man's Land, Penta, to get clues about the Sphere.

videos.title: Amo's Hospitality
videos.overview: A mysterious woman living in the No Man's Land challenges the crew from an unexpected angle.

videos.title: Something Like a Curse
videos.overview: Tamsy and Zanka fight to save their captive allies. In the aftermath, Rudo has an unexpected reaction.

videos.title: An Empty Gaze
videos.overview: Amo tells the story of how she came to the tower and of the "angels" who came to visit her.

videos.title: The Storm Before the Storm
videos.overview: After returning from the Penta No Man's Land, Rudo and the Cleaners face a series of new threats.

videos.title: Clash!
videos.overview: Taken by the Raiders to an unknown setting, the Cleaners fight for their lives, and Zodyl makes Rudo an offer.

videos.title: Gifted and Not
videos.overview: Bundus interrogates the Santas while Zanka struggles to keep pace with a powered-up Jabber.

videos.title: Memories of a Mediocrity
videos.overview: Zanka reflects on the turning point in his past that brought him to where he is today.

videos.title: Oh Zap, Totes Legit
videos.overview: While the Raiders-Cleaners conflicts continue, the battle between Riyo and Noerde heats up.

videos.title: Watchmen Series
videos.overview: Zodyl reveals his plan to reach the Sphere, and the other Cleaners react to their current circumstances.

videos.title: Ensign
videos.overview: As the battle climaxes, Enjin makes a play to unite his team, and Zodyl makes his final entreaty to Rudo.

videos.title: Race Against Time
videos.overview: Exiled from his home, Rudo seeks vengeance on those responsible. But first, he must survive a wasteland.

videos.title: The Power of Protection
videos.overview: Noerde is doing everything he can to prevent the cleaning crew from escaping before they cross the border on the haphazard contraption.

videos.title: The Man Who Will Be Stronger
videos.overview: As the Cleaners take stock after the battle, a convalescing Zanka receives some surprising news.

videos.title: Field Trip
videos.overview: Rudo and the other child Cleaners take a trip to Canvas Town while Corvus entertains some unwanted guests.
